extraction: python-pptx: all shapes (incl. groups), tables, and speaker notes. Only factual claims about OTHER people's work (papers, third-party tools/standards) are kept; statements about our own work are excluded.

claim_type_legend.quote: deck reproduces/attributes specific paper content with a locator (figure, table, equation, definition)
claim_type_legend.number: numeric value attributed to prior work or an external standard
claim_type_legend.venue: bibliographic claim (title, year, venue, authors, publication character)
claim_type_legend.capability: asserts prior work DID / HAS something
claim_type_legend.absence: asserts prior work DID NOT / LACKS / is the ONLY one - includes exclusivity and universality claims (most error-prone)
